home.heroEyebrow: Global AI Dating & Social Connection Platform
home.heroTitle: Meet people worth crossing a border for.
home.heroSubtitle: FioreMatch connects real people across 12+ languages and every timezone with AI matching that actually explains itself, and safety tools that never look away.

home.sectionHowSubtitle: No gimmicks. Three steps between you and a real connection.
home.step1Body: Add photos, your story, languages you speak, and what you're actually looking for. Our AI Profile Assistant helps you say it well without inventing anything about you.
home.step2Body: Swipe through profiles filtered by what matters — location, language, interests, and intent — while our AI quietly ranks compatibility signals in the background.
home.step3Body: When you both like each other, chat opens instantly. Every conversation is backed by moderation tools, blocking, and reporting that actually get reviewed.
home.sectionAiBody: FioreMatch's matching model looks past age and distance — shared interests, relationship goals, lifestyle, and how you actually behave on the app — and tells you why a profile was suggested with a plain-language "Why we think you may match" note. No black box, no manipulation dark patterns.

home.sectionSafetyTitle: Safety is a feature, not an afterthought

dating.title: Online Dating, Reimagined for a Global World
dating.subtitle: FioreMatch is built for people who don't want their dating pool limited by a border, a language, or a stale algorithm.
dating.intro: Whether you're looking for a relationship, something casual, or new people to build a life around, FioreMatch gives you real filters, an AI matching layer that explains itself, and a safety team that actually reviews reports — not just a swipe deck.
filters: Relationship intent — casual, dating, long-term, friendship

international.title: International Dating Without the Guesswork
international.subtitle: Cross-border relationships are harder to fake and easier to get wrong. FioreMatch is designed around that reality.
international.body1: International dating fails for predictable reasons: language gaps, mismatched expectations about intent, timezone friction, and — too often — scams targeting people who feel far from home. FioreMatch's architecture treats translation, verification signals, and honest intent-setting as core features, not afterthoughts.
international.body2: Every profile states relationship intent and spoken languages up front. Our moderation systems are tuned specifically for cross-border scam patterns — romance scams, fake military or overseas-worker personas, and urgent money requests — so you can focus on getting to know someone real.
international.tipsTitle: Dating across a border, done well
tips: Video call before you get emotionally invested — always.
Never send money, gift cards, or crypto to someone you haven't met in person.
Use in-app messaging until real trust is established.
Report anything that feels like a script, not a conversation.

safety.title: Safety Center
safety.subtitle: Dating only works if it's safe. Here's exactly what FioreMatch does — and what you should do.
platformItems: Automated spam and fake-account signal detection
Scam and fraud pattern detection, tuned for romance-scam tactics
Suspicious-behavior monitoring across likes, messages, and reports
One-tap block and report on every profile and conversation
AI-assisted content moderation with a human-reviewed queue for serious reports
Full account deletion, on request, at any time
userItems: Video call before meeting in person, every time.
Meet first dates in public places and tell a friend where you're going.
Never send money, gift cards, or crypto to someone you haven't met.
Keep conversations in the app until you've built real trust.
Report anything that feels off — you're never wrong to report.
safety.reportBody: Every profile and conversation has a Report option. Reports involving harassment, fraud signals, or safety threats are prioritized for human review.
safety.moderationNote: Our AI never makes final enforcement decisions alone on serious cases — flagged accounts are routed to a moderation queue for human review before major action is taken.

about.title: About FioreMatch
about.subtitle: A global dating platform built on one idea: real people, real matches, real safety.
about.body1: FioreMatch exists because the best relationships often start with the least likely coincidence — two people, on different sides of a border, deciding to talk. We build the product to make that coincidence more likely, and safer, without pretending distance and difference don't matter.
about.body2: We're global by design: 12 languages at launch, local pricing instead of one-size pricing, and a safety and moderation system built for cross-border risk from day one — not bolted on later.

values.name: Real users
values.desc: No fake accounts, no inflated numbers, no manufactured engagement.

values.name: Real matches
values.desc: Matching that's explainable, not a black box optimizing for time-in-app.

values.name: Real safety
values.desc: Moderation that combines AI signal detection with human judgment.

values.name: Real value
